artworks.title: The Fishing Hawk (Falco haliaetus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of an osprey perched on a fish. The artwork features an osprey standing on top of a fish with its talons firmly gripping its prey. The osprey is depicted with realistic brown and white feathers, a sharp beak, and piercing eyes. The fish lies on a small mound, with its scales and features rendered in detail. The painting captures the interplay between predator and prey with a focus on natural history and accuracy in depicting the anatomy and textures of both the bird and the fish.

artworks.title: The Small Bittern (Ardea virescens)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch. The bird has dark, earthy coloration with greenish tones on its back and a brownish chest. It has a tuft of feathers on its head, a long, pointed beak, yellowish legs and feet. The branch is surrounded by elongated leaves and seed pods. In the background, there is a water body with a small landform and grass. The drawing features detailed feathers and botanical elements, resembling classical ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: The Wood Pelican (Tantalus Loculator)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a bird. The bird is detailed with a large curved beak, elongated legs, and textured feathers. There is a faint outline of another bird's head on the left side. The drawing has meticulous linework and shading, with a minimal background.

artworks.title: The Viper-mouth (Silurus cataphractus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fish species displayed on a plain background. The top fish has armor-like scales covering its body in a pattern, with spines on its fins and along its back. Its fins are small compared to its large, rounded head and body. The bottom fish is elongated and slender with a long body that tapers towards a small tail. It has an open mouth lined with teeth and antennae-like appendages near its jaws. There is an additional element near the bottom center of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Rice-bird (Emberiza oryzivora)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: Two birds are depicted in different postures. One bird is in flight with widespread wings, an upturned head, open beak, and talons poised. The second bird is perched on the ground with wings partially spread, body angled. Both birds are detailed with feather textures and lifelike stances in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Trichoparadisea Gulielmi
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds perched on a branch. The image shows two birds with brown bodies and yellow heads, and a third bird with long, delicate feathers. The birds are standing on a branch with green leaves, against a softly clouded sky. The painting captures details like the birds' feathers and the branch texture. This is in the style of John Gould.

artworks.title: Haemanthus
artworks.artist: Johannes Jacob Haid and Johannes Elias Haid after Georg Ehret
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with large, long green leaves and a round flower head composed of thin, red and orange-tipped petals. The background is a pale off-white. In the center, the tallest leaves curve outward from the stem, and the flower head is located towards the top right. Additional detailed illustrations of individual flower parts and seeds are positioned on the left and right sides below the main plant.

artworks.title: Passenger Pigeon, Blue-mountain Warbler, and Hemlock Warbler
artworks.artist: John G. Warnicke after Alexander Wilson
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a passenger pigeon perched on a tree stump in the foreground. Two smaller birds, a blue mountain warbler and a hemlock warbler, are on a branch behind the pigeon.

artworks.title: Swallow-tailed Flycatcher, Arkansas Flycatcher, Say's Flycatcher, and Female Golden-crested Wren
artworks.artist: Alexander Lawson after Titian Ramsay Peale
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows four birds perched on tree branches. The largest bird has a gray head, white throat, and long tail. Below it, a bird with gray to yellow feathers is perched. Another bird with chocolate brown plumage is on the right side. The smallest bird has green-yellow feathers with a black and yellow crest, perched on the upper left. The color palette includes shades of brown, gray, yellow, red, and green. The branches crisscross, supporting the birds in different orientations.

artworks.title: Fork-tailed Flycatcher, Rocky Mountain Anteater, and Female Golden-winged Warbler
artworks.artist: Alexander Lawson after Titian Ramsay Peale
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: Three birds are depicted in the image: a long-tailed grey and black bird with a pale yellow tuft on its head perched at the center, a smaller brown bird standing on the ground with tufts of grass to the right, and a small yellow and grey bird sitting on a branch to the left. The color palette includes shades of grey, black, brown, and yellow. The long-tailed bird is central, with its body extending horizontally, while the brown bird is positioned on the lower right and the yellow and grey bird is on the upper left on a branch intersecting the central bird's branch.

artworks.title: Young Yellow-bellied Woodpeckers and Band-tailed Pigeon
artworks.artist: Alexander Lawson after Titian Ramsay Peale
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image features a Band-tailed Pigeon perched on a branch in the center. Above it are two Young Yellow-bellied Woodpeckers, one on a log and the other partially shown. The color palette is earthy with hints of green, blue, and red, along with natural wood textures.

artworks.title: Yellow-headed Blackbird, Female Blackbird, and Female Cape May Warbler
artworks.artist: Alexander Lawson after Titian Ramsay Peale
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds perched on branches. The image includes a larger bird with dark brown feathers and a yellow chest on a branch, a second bird with a bright yellow head and black body on the ground, and a smaller speckled bird with light brown tones reaching out to catch an insect. There is sparse vegetation with a small sprig of grass next to the branch, in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Wood Ibis, Scarlet Ibis, Flamingo, and White Ibis
artworks.artist: John G. Warnicke after Alexander Wilson
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various bird species along a body of water. The drawing portrays four birds standing on the ground next to water, with grasses around them. The birds are distinct, with unique colors and features. On the left stands a large bird with white plumage, gray-blue face, and long, yellow legs and bill. The two central birds are flamingos, one vibrant red with a prominent beak, and the other also red, bent over. To the right, a smaller white bird with subtle black and red accents stands with its long bill slightly curved. In the background, a lake stretches out, bordered by a horizon of distant land under a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man identified as Claudius Mellan. He is depicted in a three-quarters view, with his head turned towards the viewer. His facial features include prominent eyes, a narrow mustache, and a beard outlining his mouth and chin. He has medium length wavy hair falling around his ears and neck. He is wearing an elaborate shirt with a lace collar, partially covered by a cloak or draped fabric. The background has a textured pattern of lines and grids.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22 x 15.4 cm (8 11/16 x 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing the viewer with a small, pointed mustache and a goatee. He has wavy, medium-length hair, and is wearing a textured cloak with a visible clasp. The background has a grid-like texture. There is a Latin inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Nicolas-Claude Fabri de Peiresc
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.3 x 13.7 cm (8 3/8 x 5 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to his left. He has a narrow, angular face with deeply set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard with mustache. His hair is wavy, falling alongside his ears, reaching the collar of his clothing. He wears a high-collared garment with a wide, flat collar that contrasts against the darker fabric of his outer robe, which is draped and has a distinct texture. The portrait is framed by fine lines and surrounded by an inscription at the bottom that reads "NICOLAVS CLAVDIVS FABRICIVS DE PEIRESC SENATOR AQVENSIS." The background of the image is neutral with horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Nicolas-Claude Fabri de Peiresc
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.3 x 13.6 cm (7 3/16 x 5 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: This image is a portrait depicting a man's upper body, including his head and shoulders. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to the side, showing his face, long beard, and curly hair. He appears to be wearing a cap. The man has a composed expression and sharp features. He is dressed in a dark robe with a white collar, and the robe has detailed folds. The background features evenly spaced horizontal lines, creating a textured effect.

artworks.title: Nicolas-Claude Fabri de Peiresc
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: This is a detailed sketch of the upper body and head of a man. The man is positioned slightly turned to his left and has a thick beard and tousled hair. His facial features include deep-set eyes and a furrowed brow. He is wearing a skullcap and a loose-fitting garment with visible folds and textures. The background features horizontal lines. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Girolamo Frescobaldi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.1 x 9.9 cm (5 3/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. His face is bearded and mustached, with wavy hair swept back. The man is facing slightly to the right with a calm expression, wearing a dark garment with a high white collar. The oval frame surrounds him, with text around it, set against a background of intricate line patterns.

artworks.title: Urban VIII
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 26.5 x 17.3 cm (10 7/16 x 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person seated and facing slightly left, with a beard and mustache. The person wears a cap and a detailed robe with buttons and decorative trim. The background has a textured pattern. Below the portrait is a decorative panel with text "VRBANVS VIII BARBERINVS MAXIMVS," a coat of arms, and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Virginia da Vezzo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a woman facing slightly to her left. Her facial features are detailed with large eyes, delicate eyebrows, and a calm expression. Her hair is styled up with loose curls framing her face, and it's adorned with a ribbon or ornament at the back. She is wearing a dress with a broad neckline and visible lace details. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with text surrounding it. The background features dense parallel lines, and the lower section of the image contains more text.

artworks.title: Anna Maria Vaiani
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: A portrait showing the head and upper torso of a person facing forward with the head slightly turned to one side. The facial features include a round face, large eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. The curly short hair surrounds the head. The individual is wearing a detailed garment with ruffled and embroidered edges, and a full collar. They have a string of beads or pearls around the neck, which is a necklace and a pendant. The background features an oval frame with text surrounding it, providing identifying information.

artworks.title: Maddalena Corvina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman depicted from the chest up within an oval frame. She is positioned facing forward, with her head slightly turned to her left. Her facial features include high cheekbones, a pointed nose, and deep-set eyes, accentuated by detailed linework. Her hair is styled in loose curls, gathered back elegantly, with some curls softly framing her face. She wears a simple dress with a high neckline, adorned with buttons. Around her neck is a string of beads, and a visible earring hangs from her ear. The background features concentric lines radiating outward from the center of the oval, framing her against a textural backdrop. Surrounding the oval frame is text detailing the subject’s identity and possibly context related to the artist or publication.

artworks.title: Charles I de Crequi, Duke of Lesdiguières
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 24.5 x 18.9 cm (9 5/8 x 7 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The engraving features a bust portrait of a man from the mid-chest up. He is facing slightly to his right with curly hair falling just above his shoulders, a mustache, and a small patch of hair on his chin. His facial expression is neutral, with distinct features and piercing eyes. He is dressed in historical, formal attire including an ornate collar and a decorated armor breastplate. The breastplate is adorned with rivets and has a structured, metallic appearance. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame with inscribed text indicating his name and titles. The background consists of fine engraved lines radiating outward.
